```{r}
source('scripts/main_pkgs.R')
devtools::load_all()

# read output of ModernHydroModels
read_output <- function(indir) {
  fs <- dir2(indir, "Output.*.csv")
  map(fs, fread) %>% rbindlist()
}

sites <- c("松柏（二）", "县河", "房县", "延坝", "孤山")
SITE <- sites[5]
```

```{r}
f_forcing <- glue("{dir_root}/apps/data/十堰_Forcing_hourly_ALL_v20260417_basins24.csv")
forcing <- fread(f_forcing) %>% select(-Q, -R, -Z, -area_km2, -Tair) # 仅使用气象数据

# indir = glue("{dir_root}/Project_Shiyan2025/OUTPUT/version1_千里眼/")
indir <- glue("{dir_root}/Project_Shiyan2025/OUTPUT/version3_洪水摘录表_OnlyEvents")
df <- read_output(indir) %>% merge(forcing) # [site, time, P, Q_obs, Q_sim, PET_FAO98, PET_PT1972, PET_Romanenko]
```

## xgboost实战
```{r}
devtools::load_all()
sites <- c("松柏（二）", "县河", "房县", "延坝", "孤山") %>% set_names(., .)

res <- foreach(SITE = sites, i = icount()) %do% {
  fprintf("[%d] %s \n", i, SITE)

  d_full <- df[site == SITE, ] #%>% add_previous()
  xgb <- train_xgboost(d_full)
  info <- cal_pass_rate(xgb, d_full) # 合格率并未提升太多
  # c(info_pass, info_flood, gof) %<-% info
  listk(xgb, info)
}

save(res, file = "./OUTPUT/res_ModernHydro.rda")
```
